summary: Raises the Free plan from 3 to 10 collections and from 30 to 50 collection runs per month.
Rebuilt MCP server with a full tool set, now on the Free plan. The CLI and CI/CD integration also move to the Free plan, and the Free limit rises from 30 to 50 requests per collection.
**A free account is now required** to use the Free Plan. The Free Plan expands to JetBrains IDEs, WebSocket/SSE/gRPC and OAuth 2.0, capped at 3 collections of 30 requests.
Fixes mTLS client certificates not being sent reliably with Axios, and uses user-setting certificates when the workspace has none.
